headline: GTA VI downloads pushed Europe's biggest internet exchange to an all time traffic record
label: VIRAL
caption:
GTA VI did not just break sales records, it pushed the internet to its limit. 🌐

DE CIX, which runs some of the world's biggest internet exchange points, recorded its highest traffic ever on the evening before the game launched.

Traffic peaked at 33.03 terabits per second on November 18, beating the previous record set on November 10, when GTA VI pre downloads began.

Traffic during the whole launch period ran about 25 percent above a normal week, though DE CIX says game updates and streaming also added to the load.
